svg.title: Vale accepts that the evidence is sufficient even though jurisdiction is unresolved.
svg.desc: Ananya points between the signed reason log and the patient's observed readings. Vale lowers the tablet and acknowledges that the evidence is sufficient while the jurisdiction is not.
